science.qualification: Infrared false color of the whole disc from published flux densities (Chauvin et al. (2017); Cheetham et al. (2019), as compiled in Best, Liu, Magnier & Dupuy (2024), The UltracoolSheet v2.1 (Zenodo); zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service, UltracoolSheet Main.csv, HIP 65426 b: 2MASS Ks 16.9 +/- 0.06 (Chau17), 2MASS H 17.79 +/- 0.04 (Chee19), 2MASS J 19.5 +/- 0.42 (Chau17); SVO 2MASS/2MASS.Ks 666.8 Jy, 2MASS/2MASS.H 1024.0 Jy, 2MASS/2MASS.J 1594.0 Jy): red 2MASS Ks 2.159 µm, green 2MASS H 1.662 µm, blue 2MASS J 1.235 µm, on one range shared with the bodies the record names. The planet is unresolved, so no map is implied. It glows with its own heat, so no lighting.
